drafts.subject: Price query: Bellarine invoice BIC-06474 against PO 4500012124
drafts.body:
Hi R. Delaney,

Invoice BIC-06474 from Bellarine Inks & Coatings Pty Ltd ($3,327.50 inc GST) is on hold because of a price difference on line 1 (Flexo process ink - cyan).

Billed price: $12.90/kg
PO price: $12.35/kg
Difference: +4.5%, $82.50 over on this line

This breaches our 2% per-line tolerance.

Could you please confirm whether this higher price was agreed with the vendor?

- If yes, please amend the PO price to $12.90/kg so we can release the invoice for payment.
- If no, please let me know and AP will ask Bellarine for a credit note for the $82.50 difference.

Thanks,
Accounts Payable
